spans.s: खुर r. 6th cl. (खुरति) To cut, to scratch.

खुर m. (-रः)
 1. A hoof, a horse's hoof, &c.
 2. A razor.
 3. The foot of a
bedstead; also क्षुर 4. A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi, ap-
parently a dried shell fish, and of the shape of a hoof.
 E. खुर् to
cut, रन् Uṇādi affix, the radical र is dropped.

खुरक m. (-कः) A plant commonly Tila.
 E. कन् added to the preceding.

खुराक m. (-कः) An animal in general.
 E. खुर् to cut, and आक aff.

खुरक्षेप m. (-पः) A kick, kicking.
 E. खुर, and क्षेप throwing.

खुरणस् mfn. (-णाः-णाः-णः) Flat-nosed, having a nose like a horse's hoof,
E. खुर a hoof, and नस् deriv. of नासिका a nose; also with a final
vowel खुरणस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं.)

खुरपदवी f. (-वी) A horse's foot marks.
 E. खुर, and पदवी vestige.
खुरप्र m. (-प्रः) An arrow with a semicircular head: see क्षुरप्र.

खुरली f. (-ली) Military exercise, practising archery, &c.
 E. खुर् to cut,
अलच् aff.

खुराघात m. (-तः) A kick.
 E. खुर, and आघात a blow.

खुराभिघात m. (-तः)
 1. A kick.
 2. Kicking, pawing, (as a horse.)
 E. खुर,
and अभिघात striking.

खुरालक m. (-कः) An iron arrow.
 E. खुर a razor, and अल what is able,
affix कन्.

खुरालिक m. (-कः)
 1. A barber's case.
 2. An iron arrow.
 3. A pillow. E.
खुर a razor, &c. अल् to be equal to, affix ठक्; some read this खरा-
लक, but to all appearance erroneously.
खुर्द r. 1st cl. (खुर्दते or खूर्दते) To play, to sport.
खूर्द r. 1st cl. (खूर्दते) To play: see खुर्द.
